svg.title: How I build
svg.desc:
Principles, compiled. // the short version const himesh = { role: "Full Stack Engineer", basedIn: "Sri Lanka", buildsFor: ["web", "mobile", "APIs"], curiousAbout: ["AI engineering", "developer tools", "performance"],
principles: [ "Simplicity over cleverness.", "Measure first, optimise second.", "Reusable components, not copy-paste.", "Real user value over features that only look impressive.", "Sometimes the best engineering is knowing what not to build.", ], } satisfies Engineer;

text.tspan: "Real user value over features that only look impressive."
"Sometimes the best engineering is knowing what not to build."
